statement: Axeyum exhaustively enumerates the Chapter 13 width-eight A0 add-two language through cost two, replays every candidate, and finds no correct program below the printed two-add witness.
scope: Width eight; the exact six-instance mov/add alphabet printed in Chapter 13; r0 writable, r1 read-only with entry value one, other registers zero, empty memory, pc zero, running outcome; instruction-count costs zero through two; observation of final r0 and running completion.
exclusions: Arbitrary A0 instructions, registers, memory, or programs longer than two
A solver certificate or width-parametric theorem

checker.expected_result: a0-minimality: PASS: alphabet=6 strata=[1, 6, 36] minimum=2 witness=2 result_sha256=06a6550fdf29f7239d0355f8d25a271fb866c641f25452a76fa738e19ab12f30

negative_control.mutates: Remove one declared alphabet member and require both language identity and complete stratum cardinality to change

limitations: The result is exhaustive only over the declared finite width-eight candidate and input domains.
The checker directly re-executes every candidate rather than checking a separately retained solver refutation.
A separate tested control mutates the second witness instruction and requires a concrete mismatch at input one, but the manifest has one load-bearing negative-control command.
